answer.text: Your top customer last quarter was Southern Engineering Solutions Ltd at $118,428, followed by Summit Outdoor Co Ltd ($91,754), Northern Engineering Group Ltd ($89,065), Saltwater Safety Group Ltd ($87,772) and Northern Engineering Depot Ltd ($84,328).
assumptions: Revenue is net sales in NZD after discounts and returns
Covers NZ-SOUTH only, the region your role can see

sql.sql:
select c.customer_name as customer, sum(s.net_amount_nzd) as revenue
from marts.fct_sales as s
inner join marts.dim_customer as c on c.customer_key = s.customer_key
where s.order_date between %(start_date)s and %(end_date)s
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s
